task.ques: Look up the submission guidelines on ArXiv for submitting a paper and tell me the formats for figures.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: arXiv accepts PostScript figures (PS or EPS) with LaTeX processing, and JPEG, GIF, PNG, or PDF figures with PDFLaTeX processing. All figures must be included; external links cannot replace omitted figures.
Source: arXiv Submission Guidelines, “Formats for figures,” https://info.arxiv.org/help/submit/index.html#formats-for-figures (accessed October 27, 2026). Evidence: final.png.
